rationale: Identity was properly verified via name+zip. The agent correctly located the relevant orders and product variants. However, there were key policy violations: (1) The agent executed the bicycle exchange without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. It also changed multiple attributes (frame size, color, and type) without user approval. (2) For both exchanges (bicycle and camera), the agent used the Mastercard payment method instead of the user’s stated preference for Visa. (3) For the camera, while the user did consent to proceed, the agent still did not state the exact new variant and payment/refund details before executing the exchange. (4) The explanation about “only one exchange or return per delivered order” is not clearly supported by the tool output; the tool error indicates the order was no longer in a delivered state after the first exchange request. Although the skateboard cancellation was left to the user per their request, the above issues mean the agent did not complete the request in line with the policy requiring confirmation before writes and honoring the specified payment method.
